tagline: Handy tool collection for tabletop games
blurb: This app provides a few handy tools for tabletop games: * Dice (D3, D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, D100) * [ROT13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ROT13) * Number converter: Decimal Bina
description:
This app provides a few handy tools for tabletop games:
* Dice (D3, D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, D100)
* [ROT13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ROT13)
* Number converter: Decimal Binary Hexadecimal
* Timer
* Buzzers for 1 - 4 players
* List that can be randomized
